_comment: Keyword research copied 2026-11-19 from Plot Armor: Movies & TV (spoiler-blocker/src/data/shows/gta-6.json). Release: Thu Nov 19 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, unlocking at midnight local time in each store region (Rockstar/Take-Two; no PC version announced). Characters from Rockstar's character pages and trailers: Jason Duval, Lucia Caminos, Cal Hampton, Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest, Real Dimez, Raul Bautista, Brian Heder. Voice cast as reported (Nov 2026; Jason's actor not confirmed by Rockstar): Dylan Rourke (Jason), Manni L. Perez (Lucia), Bobby Moynihan (Cal), Stephen Root. Actors are weak (they appear in posts about their other work). Places: the state of Leonida with Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga. 'GTA' alone is weak: it also means the Greater Toronto Area. 'Vice City' is weak (also a nickname for Miami and the 2002 game). Jason, Lucia, Cal, Boobie and Ambrosia are everyday words, so weak. @RockstarGames is listed as an account: it mostly posts about GTA VI now (also Red Dead and GTA Online).
